trigger: The convoy halts at the canyon. Rail signal cabinet controls the crossing gates and floodlights.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The convoy stops at the canyon mouth. A dead rail signal cabinet controls the gates and floodlights on the crossing.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: Get those floods on and we can see their positions. Get the gates up and we roll through.

choices.text: [Floods only. Let them see us too]

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The floods slam on. Fifty yards up: hay trucks, pickups, men behind bales. And one you know.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: ...It's dead? Fine. Then we wait. Waiting is how people get shot, Pearce.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Floods on, gates down. Both sides blinking in the light. Nobody fires. Yet.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Behind the bales, a man in a sheepskin coat stands up with his hands empty.
